description: Hold a single Dagster step open until a condition becomes true -- Airflow's sensor-mode operators (PythonSensor, BashSensor, FileSensor, TimeSensor, TimeDeltaSensor).

outputs.description: Materializes once the condition is met (or on_timeout='skip' after a timeout).

condition.description: 'callable': callable_path() returns truthy. 'shell_exit_zero': command exits 0. 'file_exists': a path matching file_pattern exists. 'time_of_day': now (in timezone) has passed time_of_day. 'delay': delay_seconds have passed since the run's reference time. 'sftp_file_exists': sftp_path exists on the SFTP server. 's3_key_exists': s3_key exists in s3_bucket. 'gcs_object_exists': gcs_blob_name exists in gcs_bucket. 'http_ok': a GET to http_url returns a 2xx status.
condition.label: Condition

callable_path.label: Callable Path
callable_path.description: condition='callable' only (required then): 'module.path:function_name', called with no arguments each poll, returning truthy/falsy.

command.label: Command
command.description: condition='shell_exit_zero' only (required then): shell command run via bash -c each poll.

retry_exit_code.label: Retry Exit Code
retry_exit_code.description: condition='shell_exit_zero' only: this exit code means 'not ready yet, keep polling' (Airflow BashSensor's retry_exit_code). Any OTHER non-zero exit code fails immediately instead of polling further. Unset: any non-zero exit code fails immediately.

file_pattern.label: File Pattern
file_pattern.description: condition='file_exists' only (required then): a glob pattern (e.g. '/data/inbox/*.csv') checked each poll.

time_of_day.label: Time Of Day
time_of_day.description: condition='time_of_day' only (required then): 'HH:MM' (24h) in `timezone`. Met once today's wall-clock time has passed it.

delay_seconds.label: Delay Seconds
delay_seconds.description: condition='delay' only (required then): seconds after the run's reference time that must have passed.

sftp_host_env_var.label: Sftp Host Env Var
sftp_host_env_var.description: condition='sftp_file_exists' only (required then): env var with the SFTP host. Same convention as sftp_to_database_asset's host_env_var.

sftp_username_env_var.label: Sftp Username Env Var
sftp_username_env_var.description: condition='sftp_file_exists' only (required then): env var with the SFTP username.

sftp_password_env_var.label: Sftp Password Env Var
sftp_password_env_var.description: condition='sftp_file_exists': env var with the SFTP password. Set this OR sftp_private_key_env_var.

sftp_private_key_env_var.label: Sftp Private Key Env Var
sftp_private_key_env_var.description: condition='sftp_file_exists': env var with a path to an SSH private key file. Set this OR sftp_password_env_var.

sftp_path.label: Sftp Path
sftp_path.description: condition='sftp_file_exists' only (required then): remote file path checked via SFTP each poll. Exact path for match_mode='exact'; for 'prefix'/'wildcard' this is the pattern matched against a directory listing (see sftp_match_mode).

sftp_match_mode.label: Sftp Match Mode
sftp_match_mode.description: condition='sftp_file_exists': 'exact' stats sftp_path directly. 'prefix' lists sftp_path's directory and succeeds if any entry's name starts with sftp_path's basename. 'wildcard' lists the same directory and succeeds if any entry matches sftp_path's basename as an fnmatch glob (e.g. '*.csv').

s3_bucket.label: S3 Bucket
s3_bucket.description: condition='s3_key_exists' only (required then): S3 bucket name.

s3_key.label: S3 Key
s3_key.description: condition='s3_key_exists' only (required then): checked each poll. Exact object key for match_mode='exact'; for 'prefix'/'wildcard' this is the pattern matched via list_objects_v2.

s3_match_mode.label: S3 Match Mode
s3_match_mode.description: condition='s3_key_exists': 'exact' calls head_object on s3_key directly. 'prefix' lists objects under s3_key as a prefix and succeeds if at least one exists. 'wildcard' lists objects under the portion of s3_key before its first '*'/'?' and succeeds if any listed key matches the full s3_key pattern via fnmatch.

aws_region.label: Aws Region
aws_region.description: condition='s3_key_exists': AWS region. Unset uses boto3's default credential/region chain.

gcs_bucket.label: Gcs Bucket
gcs_bucket.description: condition='gcs_object_exists' only (required then): GCS bucket name.

gcs_blob_name.label: Gcs Blob Name
gcs_blob_name.description: condition='gcs_object_exists' only (required then): checked each poll. Exact object name for match_mode='exact'; for 'prefix'/'wildcard' this is the pattern matched via list_blobs.

gcs_match_mode.label: Gcs Match Mode
gcs_match_mode.description: condition='gcs_object_exists': 'exact' checks gcs_blob_name directly via blob.exists(). 'prefix' lists blobs under gcs_blob_name as a prefix and succeeds if at least one exists. 'wildcard' lists blobs under the portion of gcs_blob_name before its first '*'/'?' and succeeds if any listed name matches the full gcs_blob_name pattern via fnmatch.

gcs_credentials_env_var.label: Gcs Credentials Env Var
gcs_credentials_env_var.description: condition='gcs_object_exists': env var with a path to a GCP service account JSON key file. Unset uses application-default credentials. Same convention as gcs_to_database_asset's credentials_env_var.

http_url.label: Http Url
http_url.description: condition='http_ok' only (required then): URL checked each poll. A response whose status is in http_success_status_codes (default 2xx) means met; anything else (including a connection error) means not yet met.

http_method.label: Http Method
http_method.description: condition='http_ok': HTTP method used for each poll (GET, POST, HEAD, ...).

http_headers.description: condition='http_ok': extra headers sent with each poll request, on top of any auth header from http_auth_type.
http_headers.label: Http Headers

http_success_status_codes.description: condition='http_ok': explicit list of status codes that count as met (e.g. [200] if 202/404 should mean 'not yet' rather than success). Unset defaults to any 2xx status, matching prior behavior.
http_success_status_codes.label: Http Success Status Codes

http_auth_type.label: Http Auth Type
http_auth_type.description: condition='http_ok': auth to attach to the request. Same convention as per_row_http_fetcher's auth_type (oauth2 not offered here -- a poll check has no use for a short-lived token refresh loop).

http_auth_username_env_var.label: Http Auth Username Env Var
http_auth_username_env_var.description: condition='http_ok', http_auth_type='basic' only (required then): env var with the basic-auth username.

http_auth_password_env_var.label: Http Auth Password Env Var
http_auth_password_env_var.description: condition='http_ok', http_auth_type='basic' only (required then): env var with the basic-auth password.

http_auth_token_env_var.label: Http Auth Token Env Var
http_auth_token_env_var.description: condition='http_ok', http_auth_type='bearer' only (required then): env var with the bearer token.

http_timeout_seconds.label: Http Timeout Seconds
http_timeout_seconds.description: condition='http_ok': request timeout in seconds for each poll.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Give up after this many seconds total.

on_timeout.label: On Timeout
on_timeout.description: 'fail' (default): raise and fail the run. 'skip': a real Dagster structural skip (AssetOut(is_required=False), the output is never yielded) -- this asset and every downstream asset depending on it are marked skipped, not materialized, matching Airflow's soft_fail semantics. Same mechanism conditional_asset uses for its gate/branch outputs.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds
